summary: Every party is a ticket: its time sits on a perforated stub, and the owner's day reads like a stage call sheet, one row per animator, with the three problems pinned above it.

world.name: Ticket Stub
world.summary: Cool paper, deep indigo ink and one orchid accent. Sofia Sans, a Bulgarian-made family, with Bulgarian letterforms switched on. Parties are tickets; status lives on the ticket.
world.signature: The ticket stub: every party card has a time stub cut off by a dashed perforation with two punched notches. The stub carries the start and end time in condensed numerals; a missing deposit turns the whole ticket red.
rules: Do put every party on a ticket: time on the stub, child, age and package on the body, status inside the ticket.
Do set times and counts in the condensed display face with tabular numbers.
Do use the orchid accent once per screen, for the one thing that is next or selected. Never for a problem.
Don't use solid red for anything but a missing deposit. Clashes, missing animators and leave that needs cover are amber, never filled.
Don't print empty time as text; empty time stays white space on the grid.
Don't invent money: an unknown amount shows as a dashed 'не е зададено' slot.

components.name: App shell
components.what: Frame of every screen: Top bar, the page area that takes the screen's sections as children, and the Phone tab bar; takes the role (owner or animator) and the current tab.

components.name: Top bar
components.what: Sticky bar with the fox logo, a Nav link per main tab, party search for the owner and the signed-in Person; on a phone only the logo and avatar stay.

components.name: Nav link
components.what: One main tab: icon, label and an optional Count badge. Looks: top (underlined when current) and phone (icon in a soft pill when current). Owner tabs: Day, Orders, Leave, Customers; animator tabs: My parties, Leave, Pay.

components.name: Phone tab bar
components.what: Bottom bar on phones that renders a Nav link per tab.

components.name: Count badge
components.what: Small solid pill on a Nav link with how many orders or leave requests are waiting; hidden when the count is zero.

components.name: Page header
components.what: Title in the condensed display face, a muted line of counts under it, and an optional actions slot on the right (Date stepper, Ново парти, Search field).

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.what: Path from the day back to the open booking.

components.name: Card
components.what: Plain surface panel that takes children: order detail boxes, booking boxes, leave requests, calendars, pay summary and list.

components.name: Divided list
components.what: Rows split by thin lines; takes its rows as children (Past party, Provider row, Animator day line).

components.name: Legend
components.what: Row of small swatches with labels under a calendar: approved, pending, declined leave and a party that needs cover.

components.name: Button
components.what: One button with variants: primary (one per area, e.g. Schedule, Approve), outline default, quiet link-like, small, icon-only, and light or outline versions that sit on the red Deposit alert.

components.name: Avatar
components.what: Round initial for a person; a dashed amber '?' marks the row of parties without an animator.

components.name: Person
components.what: Avatar with a name and an optional role line: the signed-in user, an animator in the lane, on a leave request, on the leave calendar and in the booking's animator box.

components.name: Status tag
components.what: Small outlined label for a state: amber for a clash, no animator, missing address or leave that needs cover (never filled); soft indigo for new, pending or approved; teal for a large party; orchid for a birthday nobody has asked about; grey for neutral facts.

components.name: Deposit mark
components.what: Deposit state on a party: the solid red 'Депозит липсва' badge, the only solid red in the product, or a green check 'Депозит платен' (short 'Платен' on narrow tickets).

components.name: Time range
components.what: Start and end time in condensed tabular numerals, e.g. 15:00–16:00, on problem cards, leave blocks and the animator's day strip.

components.name: Unset amount
components.what: Dashed empty slot reading 'не е зададено' wherever an amount is not known yet (party share, bonus, each party's amount); never an invented figure.

components.name: Search field
components.what: Search box with a magnifier: party search in the owner's Top bar and the large family, child or phone search on customers.

components.name: Date stepper
components.what: Previous / today / next buttons around the shown day on ops-day and the shown month on pay.

components.name: Segmented switch
components.what: Two-way switch: Day / Week view on ops-day, Whole days / A few hours on the leave form; the chosen side is filled.

components.name: Filter chips
components.what: Row of pill filters with counts (All, New, Missing info, No animator, Scheduled; Repeat, Large, New, Birthday soon); the chosen one is filled ink, problem filters use amber text.

components.name: Ticket
components.what: The signature layout: a time or date stub cut off by a dashed perforation with two punched notches, and a body slot. Kinds: normal, danger (whole ticket red, red stub), warn (amber outline), open (dashed amber), next or selected (orchid stub). Party ticket, Order ticket, Birthday ticket and Past party are built on it.

components.name: Party ticket
components.what: One party on a Ticket: start and end on the stub, child, age, package and a Deposit mark or Status tag. Sizes: lane (placed by time in a Day track, address line), list (phone list and upcoming, with address, Navigate and phone), hero (today's or the open booking, with address box and Navigate / Call / Copy actions), compact (in a Needs-cover box), pay (in a Pay line).

components.name: Party list
components.what: Parties in time order as list-size Party tickets, with approved leave in its place: the owner's phone day list and the animator's upcoming parties.

components.name: Party chip
components.what: A party reduced to its Time range and the child's name, placed on the animator's day strip or in a Month day; red when the deposit is missing, amber outline when inside requested leave.

components.name: Leave block
components.what: Hatched grey block for approved leave with its hours and 'одобрен', in a Day track, the phone day list, today's note and a Month day; empty time otherwise stays blank.

components.name: Problem strip
components.what: Pinned above the owner's day: the count of things to fix and one Problem card each.

components.name: Problem card
components.what: One thing to fix today, with a coloured top edge. Kinds: missing deposit (red edge, Deposit mark, 'Депозитът е получен'), clash (amber, the two parties, Free-animator picks) and no animator (amber, Free-animator picks with 'след HH:MM').

components.name: Free-animator pick
components.what: Pill button with the Avatar and name of an animator who is free at that time, with an optional 'след 16:00' hint; one tap assigns them to the party.

components.name: Animator lane
components.what: The owner's day: an Hour ruler across the top and one Animator row plus Day track per animator, with a last row for parties without an animator.

components.name: Animator row
components.what: One animator's cell in the lane: Person, role, party count and a Status tag when they have a clash; the '?' version heads the no-animator row.

components.name: Day track
components.what: One animator's day with hours across: Party tickets or Party chips placed by time, Leave blocks, and a striped amber clash band with its label where two parties overlap. The owner's lane row and the animator's own day strip.

components.name: Hour ruler
components.what: Hour labels in condensed numerals over or under a Day track.

components.name: Order list
components.what: The inbox list, newest first: one Order ticket per site order.

components.name: Order ticket
components.what: One site order on a Ticket: the party date and time on the stub, parent, child, package, guests, when it arrived and its Status tags; the selected order gets the orchid stub, one needing a decision an amber outline.

components.name: Order detail
components.what: The selected order: Status tags, title, Call / Reply, the Step list as pills, the Parent note, party and family boxes and the Schedule form.

components.name: Schedule form
components.what: Date, time and animator fields with 'Насрочи партито' that turns a site order into a booking.

components.name: Parent note
components.what: Teal callout with the note the parent typed into the site form.

components.name: Step list
components.what: The nine steps from site order to pay, one Step each: a line across on desktop, a vertical list on phones with done steps folded into one line, and a compact pill row on the inbox detail.

components.name: Step
components.what: One booking step with its label and date. States: done (indigo check), missing (red '!', only for the deposit), next (orchid ring), to do; the pill look on the inbox marks the current step.

components.name: Deposit alert
components.what: Solid red block on a booking whose deposit is missing: big 'Депозит липсва', when the reminder was sent, and 'Маркирай като получен' / 'Напомни пак'.

components.name: Message list
components.what: Messages sent to the parent, newest last.

components.name: Message
components.what: One message to the parent: channel, when, text; the deposit reminder is tinted red.

components.name: Provider row
components.what: One external provider on a booking: what, who, and its state as a Status tag.

components.name: Animator day line
components.what: One line of the booked animator's day in the booking's animator box: a party's Time range and child with its Deposit mark, or their leave.

components.name: Past party
components.what: One party a family has had: date, child, package and guests, with a Deposit mark if it was missing. Looks: row (inbox and booking family boxes) and ticket (the selected family's history on customers, with a Guest bar).

components.name: Leave request
components.what: One leave request: who (Person), when sent, the date range in large numerals, the reason or 'Без причина', the state and a Needs-cover box. Looks: owner card with Approve / Decline, the animator's own card (cancel while pending) and a decided row with the owner's note.

components.name: Leave request list
components.what: The owner's pending requests as cards, and the decided ones as rows.

components.name: Needs-cover box
components.what: Amber box inside a Leave request listing the parties that would lose their animator as compact Party tickets; a green line instead when no party is affected.

components.name: Leave calendar
components.what: Animators down, the next weeks across, weekends shaded and today in orchid, one Leave bar per request and an amber balloon mark on a day with a party that needs cover; Legend below.

components.name: Leave bar
components.what: A leave request on the Leave calendar: solid for approved, dashed and hatched for pending, struck-through for declined, a clock for a few hours.

components.name: Month grid
components.what: The animator's own four weeks, Monday first, one Month day per date; Legend below.

components.name: Month day
components.what: One date in the Month grid: the day number (orchid when today, faded when past), its Party chips and approved hours of leave; hatched when inside pending leave.

components.name: Family list
components.what: All families: a table on desktop (children and birthdays, party count, last party, most guests, tags, what is on now) and a stack of cards on phones.

components.name: Family
components.what: One family. Looks: table row (the selected one opens its Past parties as tickets below) and phone card, with repeat, large and new Status tags, a Deposit mark and an open order.

components.name: Guest bar
components.what: Short bar for the most guests a family has had, teal when the party is large (30 or more).

components.name: Birthday list
components.what: Card of children turning older in the next 30 days, one Birthday ticket each.

components.name: Birthday ticket
components.what: One upcoming birthday on a Ticket: the date on the stub, child and age they turn, family, and whether a party or order is booked; nobody-asked-yet gets an orchid outline and 'Пиши на родителя'.

components.name: Month total
components.what: Dashed box with the month's total, shown as 'не е зададена' until the animator cut and bonus are supplied.

components.name: Stat tile
components.what: Grey tile with a large count and its label: parties played, hours so far, today and upcoming.

components.name: Pay list
components.what: The month's parties with column heads, grouped into played and today / upcoming with counts and hours; one Pay line each.

components.name: Pay line
components.what: One party in the month's pay: its pay-size Party ticket, hours, and an Unset amount.

components.name: Field
components.what: Label above a control: date, time and animator when scheduling an order; from, to and reason on the leave form.

components.name: Select
components.what: Drop-down to choose an animator when scheduling a site order, showing name and role.

components.name: Textarea
components.what: Multi-line text for the optional leave reason; the same control holds notes in the decline and pay-error dialogs.

components.name: Date picker
components.what: Calendar in a popover: one date when scheduling an order, a from-to range on the animator's leave form that shows their parties inside the range before sending.

components.name: Change animator picker
components.what: Searchable list in a popover, opened by 'Смени', of animators who are free at the party's time, with who is busy or on leave shown disabled; choosing one reassigns the booking.

components.name: Approve with cover dialog
components.what: Opened by 'Одобри и намери заместник': lists each party the leave leaves uncovered with a pick of free animators, and approves the leave once every party has a cover.

components.name: Decline leave dialog
components.what: Opened by 'Откажи': asks the owner for a short note to the animator and declines; the note then shows as 'Твоята бележка' under decided leave.

components.name: Pay error dialog
components.what: Opened by 'Има грешка': the animator picks the wrong party or hours from the month's list and writes what is wrong for the owner.

components.name: Confirm dialog
components.what: Short yes / no before a step that can't quietly be undone: marking a deposit received ('Депозитът е получен', 'Маркирай като получен'), cancelling a pending leave request, confirming the month's pay list is correct.

components.name: Message composer
components.what: Side panel to write to a parent ('Отговори' on an order, 'Напомни пак' about a deposit, 'Пиши на родителя' for a birthday) with the channel, a prefilled text and send.

components.name: New party form
components.what: Side panel opened by 'Ново парти' to enter a booking by hand: child, age, package, date, time, address and parent.

components.name: Toast
components.what: Short note after an action is done, e.g. deposit marked received, leave request sent, address copied.

components.name: Tooltip
components.what: Hover text with the full child, time and address on narrow roster tickets, and the party behind a cover mark on the leave calendar.
